_doc: Route segments per zone. Velocities: vx forward m/s, vy left m/s, vyaw left-turn rad/s (positive = counter-clockwise). Hard caps in patrol/dog/real.py: vx 0.5, vy 0.3, vyaw 0.8, segment 10 s. A zone runs only if calibrated=true (set after a supervised test, HAC-4).
